channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Netflix Builds Quasar to Measure the Blast Radius of Library API Changes
item.description: Netflix developed Quasar, an internal tool that combines semantic code indexing and API comparisons to identify downstream consumers affected by library changes. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: From Fan-Out to Fast: Sub-100ms API Design in Distributed Systems
item.description: Saranya Vedagiri explains how to design resilient, low-latency distributed APIs under 100ms. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Article: Engineering Reliable Telematics from Smartphone Sensors
item.description: Smartphones make telematics more accessible by combining location, motion sensors, computing power, and connectivity in a single device. (1 source: infoq)
